definitions.explanation: A bullet fired from a gun.

examples.japanese: {銃弾|じゅうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{交|か}う。
⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{銃弾|じゅうだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The soldier took a bullet in the leg.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{数発|すうはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{銃弾|じゅうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Several bullets were found at the scene of the crime.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {銃弾|じゅうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to be shot dead
- {銃弾|じゅうだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to be riddled with bullets
- {銃弾|じゅうだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be hit by a bullet
Bullets are counted with 〜⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弾丸|だんがん}→弾丸：12502_dangan⟧: bullet, projectile; also figurative (⟦{弾丸|だんがん}→弾丸：12502_dangan⟧⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧, a whirlwind trip)
- ⟦{弾|たま}→弾：28121_tama⟧: the everyday word for a bullet

WATCH OUT:
⟦{縦断|じゅうだん}→縦断：09035_juudan⟧ (traveling the length of a country) has the same reading.
